blocks.text: SOP: heavy-duty drivetrain inspection

This is the working cut for RDW-SOP-2022-062 on November 22, 2022. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Road-test listen, no hoist look if time is short) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host bay-03.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on send a clunk as normal for the miles, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Hoist, chock, pry U-joints, check yoke nuts, look for leaks. Write the play. Do not send a clunk as character. I am not restating a hallway yes. send a clunk as normal for the miles is out because November 3 comeback at 40 miles, U-joint on the floor. Miles are not a spec. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: miles=40, joints=2, weeks=3, pry=1, leak=1, clunk=1, hoist=1, spec=0. Sibling tickets RDW-2477 and RDW-SOP-2023-014. I will not reopen send a clunk as normal for the miles in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: hoist.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (38): refuse on send a clunk as normal for the miles, lock is hoist look, write play, clunk is not character. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-2477.
Play you can see with a pry bar is not 'it has always been like that.'

What a skeptical lead would try first on bay-03.ridgeway.internal: the path Cal Dreher actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on shop.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
